sources.title: Boda confirms Qianhai No. 1 support for Fubon Bank Shenzhen operating services
sources.summary: Operator confirms its Qianhai No. 1 campus supports the core systems of the now-open Fubon Bank (Hong Kong) Shenzhen branch and forms a dual-active architecture with Humeng Wulian. Confirmation concerns active infrastructure service, not a new data-centre opening or full-campus occupancy.
sources.date_semantics: August 26 is the dated operator confirmation of current service. Exact branch-opening, tenant go-live and data-centre opening days are not established.
